rule: An order line appears once per export
action: Remove exact duplicates before loading; ask IT why the delta export overlaps

rule: Every order line points to a supplier that exists in the supplier master
action: Create or map one-time vendors; spend stays visible as "unknown supplier" until fixed

rule: Every order line has a material group (category)
action: Classify from the description with keyword rules; make the field mandatory in ERP_B

rule: Unit price is within 20x of the median price of the same material
action: Lines about 1000x the median are priced per tonne on a per-kg line; divide by 1000 and correct in the ERP
Negative quantities are returns; report them separately instead of netting them into spend
Fill from the VAT ID prefix or the matched record in the other ERP

rule: One real company has one golden supplier record
action: Merge by VAT ID or normalised name; near-matches with conflicting VAT IDs or legal forms go to manual review

rule: Payment terms use one format that converts to net days
action: Harmonise to net days; agree one terms catalogue for both ERPs

rule: A goods receipt is not dated before its order
action: Exclude from delivery performance until corrected

rule: No orders are placed with a blocked supplier
action: Review why the supplier is blocked and whether the orders were authorised

rule: Every supplier has a VAT ID
action: Request from the supplier at the next master data review

rule: The material group in ERP_A matches the category the description implies
action: Correct the material group; checks that the keyword classifier is safe to use for ERP_B
